project: EdTech Astro Website Revamp & Sveltia CMS Integration
overview: Redesign the Astro website for a brighter EdTech vibe, preserve SEO by restoring old URLs, make it fully responsive, and integrate Sveltia CMS for non-technical editors.
goals: Redesign the website to have a brighter, welcoming EdTech aesthetic.
Preserve SEO by recreating old website URLs and their content.
Ensure 100% responsiveness across mobile, tablet, and desktop.
Integrate Sveltia CMS for reliable, easy content editing by non-technical users.
nonGoals: No backend API or custom dynamic CMS server.
No third-party integrations beyond existing social/contact links.
No student portal, user authentication (for users), or video hosting.
No complex payment processing or checkout.
No modifications to the core Markdown schema structure.
successMetrics: Lighthouse scores remain high (LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.1, INP < 200ms).
Zero 404 routing errors to preserve SEO.
Zero build breaks or validation errors caused by frontmatter mismatches.
100% successful authentication and Git commit workflows via Sveltia CMS.
openQuestions: Are there specific brand colors or typography guidelines for the 'EdTech vibe'?
Do we have a complete list of legacy URLs that must be recreated?

routes.name: Preserved Legacy Routes
routes.purpose: Match old website URLs for SEO.

uiNotes: Move away from dark themes; adopt a brighter, professional EdTech vibe.
Ensure dynamic forms and banner CTAs do not cause layout shifts (CLS < 0.1).
Must be fully responsive across all device types.
rules: Sveltia CMS must only edit existing content collection structures.
All new pages must perfectly match the URL structure of the legacy site.

stories.title: Redesign UI for EdTech Vibe & Responsiveness
stories.description: As a user, I want to see a bright, welcoming, responsive design that feels like a professional EdTech platform.
acceptanceCriteria: Update the global CSS/Tailwind configuration to a brighter color palette.
Remove excessively dark elements across the site.
Ensure all pages render correctly and responsively on mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
Example: Homepage hero section looks vibrant and scales down correctly on mobile.
Negative case: Text lacks sufficient contrast against new backgrounds (fails WCAG accessibility checks).

stories.title: URL Migration and SEO Preservation
stories.description: As an SEO manager, I want all legacy URLs to map correctly to new Astro pages with their respective content.
acceptanceCriteria: Create new Astro page files (or dynamic routes) mapping to all legacy URLs.
Populate pages with migrated content to preserve SEO.
Negative case: A legacy URL returns a 404 error during tests.

stories.title: Integrate Sveltia CMS
stories.description: As a non-technical editor, I want to use Sveltia CMS to manage content reliably without touching code.
acceptanceCriteria: Install and setup Sveltia CMS at the /admin route (e.g. creating `public/admin/index.html` and `public/admin/config.yml`).
Configure CMS schema to map to the existing Astro Content Collections without modifying the frontmatter structure.
Configure GitHub/Cloudflare Pages auth for Sveltia CMS.
Example: Logging in to /admin and editing a markdown post successfully creates a Git commit.
Negative case: Saving a post corrupts the frontmatter schema and breaks `npm run check`.

stories.title: Performance Optimization & Validation
stories.description: As a user, I want the site to load quickly and not shift around as it renders.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit and fix any components causing layout shifts to ensure CLS < 0.1.
Optimize images and assets to ensure LCP < 2.5s.
Example: Running Lighthouse locally or in CI yields a performance score > 90.
Negative case: Dynamic banner loading pushes content down, resulting in CLS > 0.1.
